text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Murmur, murmur...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I really wanted McQueen to win today...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I've been camping on this spot for a whole
week just to see her get
her third win with
my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Rice...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eheheh... They're all disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I heard there was a sight you wanted me to
see, but all I see is a
repeat of the Kikuka
Sho...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I knew this would happen, but...
still, it... it hurts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...When I was disqualified in the autumn
Tenno Sho, I felt much the
same way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Knowing I'd betrayed the hopes of so
many, I found it difficult to
carry on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But then, I saw it—the sight I speak of.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: The sight...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you'll see it too. Come on, now.
We're up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Ah!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Murmur, murmur...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's Rice Shower! Why'd you have to
deny her third win, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: We came here to see McQueen win!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, we gotta drown them out! Good
going, Rice! You're the best!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: You... you ran well.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ayy! You get it! Now gimme one more, in a
voice she can hear this
time!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! O-okay!
You ran well!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: There are people cheering... for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And this is the sight only a victor can see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Those who placed their hopes in you,
those who had their hopes
dashed...
Standing here, you can see all their faces.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To take all those emotions in—the good
and the bad—is the duty of a
victor, and
also her pride.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A victor's duty... and pride...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For the fans who put even the slightest of
hopes in you... And for the
fans who hoped
against you... For all their sakes, stand tall.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now, time to show them what a true victor
looks like.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Okay!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
All the people disappointed that I
won—they'll be even more
disappointed if
I don't look like I belong up here.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I need to stand tall—look them all in the
eye, and show them that I'll
keep on
running...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Until one day, I become an Umamusume they'll be happy to see win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I have high hopes for you, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The concert begins, marking not only
Rice's victory but also
McQueen's crushing
defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And yet, Rice sings with far more spirit
than she did after the Kikuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: McQueen, you did well out there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Rice has noticed what she's
been lacking this entire time.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: I could tell from her singing.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: I could tell from her singing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, what a disgrace for me though. I was
the one who asked you to
enter her in the
race, and here I am defeated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: She really did... perform wonderfully.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's not exaggerating. Rice ran better
than I've ever seen her run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the same goes for McQueen. I could
feel how much she wanted
her third title.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I was just one step away... I wanted to win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sob. Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She ran with a lot on her shoulders today.
The weight of her ambition.
Her duties as
team ace. And I have nothing but
gratitude for her
efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower must see that too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The witch had nobody to turn to. But one
day, a boy came to visit
her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "I want to soar across the sky like a bird."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The witch gladly cast a spell on the boy,
and he smiled, for his wish
had come true.
"Wow! This is incredible!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
After seeing that, the others started to
visit the witch too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Some were still scared, but day by day,
more and more people began
to smile.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The witch wanted to make everyone
happy, so she cast spell after
spell, sparing
none of her power.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But one day, she suddenly became unable
to use magic.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Using so much had tired her out, and she
collapsed from exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who had once feared the witch
then realized how hard she
had worked to
make them happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Now that they knew her true feelings, they
began to care for her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
They all eagerly awaited the day she
would become healthy enough
to use
magic again.
